evidence.quoted_text:
self.run_dir = base / name
        self.run_dir.mkdir(mode=0o700)
        return self.run_dir
evidence.reason: `claim_run_dir` creates the run directory and returns without syncing the record base directory. `durable_write(path, receipt)` syncs the receipt file and its parent (`self.run_dir`), but not the `base` entry that names the new run directory, nor `base`'s parent when `base.mkdir(parents=True)` creates it. A crash after admission can therefore leave the host held while losing the run directory/recovery receipt. The code should fsync `base` after `self.run_dir.mkdir(...)`, and also persist `base`'s parent entry when it was created. This is a routine durability repair, not a new contract requirement.
